answer: Consider Electricity smart-meter usage fingerprint as the gate. With usage curves that only one household makes in place, the thread an attacker faces is not a puzzle to solve once but a cost paid per identity. Honest agents already carry what Electricity smart-meter usage fingerprint asks for, so they pass without noticing; the mesa is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the fable is that the farm's unit economics never work.
